entry_route.value: Applicants can enter on the BS-entry PhD, which skips the master's, or on the MS-entry PhD.
entry_route.quote: The BS-entry PhD is an accelerated program in which the student bypasses the master's thesis and proceeds directly to dissertation research.

also.quote: Doctor of Philosophy in Mechanical Engineering (MS Entry)

gre_general.value: The mechanical page sets no GRE rule. The aerospace BS-entry PhD requires GRE 153 Verbal and 159 Quantitative for unconditional admission.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores of at least 153 on the Verbal and 159 on the Quantitative subtests.

funding.value: Fellowships and assistantships go to applicants whose skills fit program needs; no funding is promised to everyone.
funding.quote: Applicants who demonstrate skills, experience or interests that meet the needs of the AE Graduate Program will be considered for fellowships or assistantships

supervisor.value: A faculty advisor is needed by the second semester, which is not an admission rule.

gre_subject.value: No subject test is named for mechanical engineering.

deadline.value: The page gives no application deadline.

notes: One record for the Mechanical PhD (BS and MS entry) and the Aerospace PhD (BS and MS entry), which share the department. The aerospace GRE rule is shown on gre_general; the mechanical page is silent on the GRE. The aerospace page gives TOEFL iBT 84 as a preference, not a minimum.
name: Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering PhD
